thought.text: `docker compose up --wait` exited 0. All infrastructure healthy, including my custom-built MinIO image. Let me verify the keycloak-bootstrap succeeded and MinIO buckets were created:

reasoning_content:
`docker compose up --wait` exited with 0. All infrastructure containers are healthy:
- workspace-minio-1: Healthy (our custom-built image works!)
- workspace-temporal-1: Healthy
- workspace-temporal-ui-1: Healthy
- workspace-postgresql-1: Healthy
- workspace-keycloak-1: Healthy
- workspace-oauth2-proxy-1: Healthy
- spicedb: Healthy
- workspace-qdrant-1: Healthy (no healthcheck but up)
- keycloak-bootstrap: Exited (that's expected — it ran once successfully to bootstrap the user)

The keycloak-bootstrap container "Exited" — that's expected because it's a one-shot bootstrap job. Let me verify it exited with code 0 (success).

Now let me verify the Keycloak bootstrap succeeded and check the minio buckets were created. Let me also verify the infrastructure is actually working (Keycloak login, MinIO buckets, Temporal).

Let me check the keycloak-bootstrap exit code and MinIO buckets.

action.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== keycloak-bootstrap exit code ==="
docker inspect --format '{{.State.ExitCode}}' workspace-keycloak-bootstrap-1
echo "=== keycloak-bootstrap log tail ==="
docker logs workspace-keycloak-bootstrap-1 2>&1 | tail -8
echo "=== MinIO buckets (via mc) ==="
# use env creds from .env
source <(grep -E "^(S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID|S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY)=" .env)
docker run --rm --network workspace_default minio/mc:latest \
  alias set local http://minio:9000 "$S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID" "$S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" >/dev/null 2>&1
docker run --rm --network workspace_default minio/mc:latest --config-dir /tmp/mc alias set local http://minio:9000 "$S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID" "$S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "--- list buckets ---"
docker run --rm -v /tmp/mcdata:/root/.mc --network workspace_default minio/mc:latest alias set local http://minio:9000 "$S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID" "$S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" >/dev/null 2>&1
